recipe_coverage: Ordinary cycling component only, through the real hand-ability proxy/menu. Explicit pinned cycling cost, both players, discard and payment before stack resolution, ordered draws and multiplicities, independent copies, cancellation/insufficient or wrong mana, combat/opposing turn, own/opposing cost reduction and taxes, pending/resolved snapshots after AI backups, and reclaim/exile of the discarded source while the draw is pending. Cast effects, battlefield abilities and multiplayer remain gaps. Additional cycling/discard triggers, nonstandard cycling costs and alternate hand/graveyard mechanics are excluded. Ordinary draw/discard pipelines through real spells, activations and creature entry/death. Oracle-pinned ordered operations distinguish costs from effects, recipients, fixed/discard-derived amounts and random subsets. Both controllers exercise exact costs, empty/short/uneven/duplicate hands, legal human choices, per-card hand/grave conservation, exact remaining libraries, source removal/re-entry, and caller-owned snapshots where applicable. Random distribution, alternate source abilities/costs, replacement/discard triggers, control changes and multiplayer remain component gaps.
